class.name: TweensGdPlaybackOptions
class.brief_description: Clock and pause policy for one playback root.
class.description: Supplied separately from definitions as the last argument to play, play_all, chain, or scheduler starts. Tweens.playback_options(process_mode, pause_mode, use_unscaled_time) creates it. Settings are snapshotted at the factory; later changes do not affect playback. A Chain uses one policy for all leaves. C# equivalent: PlaybackOptions.

members.member: BOUND, SCENE_TREE, or ALWAYS. Explicit pause always applies.
Ignores Engine.time_scale. Physics uses fixed simulation steps.
